taxonomy.description: One party receives exclusive rights — an exclusive license, exclusive dealing, or a promise not to license/appoint others for the same scope. Source = the granting/bound party, target = the party receiving exclusivity or the exclusive scope.
A party is restricted from competing — operating, selling, or engaging in a competing business or products.
A party may terminate WITHOUT cause — for convenience, at will, or on notice alone. Not termination for breach.
Assignment of the agreement or its rights requires consent or notice, or is prohibited.
A party may audit or inspect the other's books, records, or compliance.
Liability is capped or limited — to an amount, to fees paid, or by excluding damage categories.
Intellectual property created under or covered by the agreement becomes the counterparty's property (assignment or work-made-for-hire), or ownership is expressly allocated.
The agreement names its governing law or jurisdiction.
